description: This PHP file defines a wrapper class 'SugarTinyMCE' that manages TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor configurations, including different toolbar sets, plugins, and initialization scripts, as well as loading custom configurations and cleaning HTML output.

classes.name: SugarTinyMCE
classes.description: A PHP class providing configuration and initialization for the TinyMCE WYSIWYG HTML editor, with support for multiple toolbar configurations, language settings, and custom overrides.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarTinyMCE class, loading custom button configs, default configs, and language configs.

methods.name: resolveConfigType
methods.description: Resolves legacy configuration type aliases to semantic config names.

methods.name: validateConfigType
methods.description: Validates that the configuration type is one of the allowed types; falls back to 'standard' if invalid.

methods.name: buildConfig
methods.description: Builds the TinyMCE configuration array based on the specified type.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the TinyMCE configuration array for a given type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to initialize TinyMCE on specified DOM targets.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code defining the TinyMCE configuration object for a given type.

methods.name: cleanEncodedMCEHtml
methods.description: Removes TinyMCE-specific HTML encoding artifacts from provided HTML.

methods.name: overloadButtonConfigs
methods.description: Loads custom button configurations from an external PHP config file if available.

methods.name: overloadDefaultConfigs
methods.description: Loads and merges custom default TinyMCE configs from an external PHP config file if available.

methods.name: overloadLanguageConfigs
methods.description: Sets language-related default configs based on the current language and available language files.
